title: Customer Experience Engineer, L1
description_excerpt: Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. CXE 1 investigates real technical problems across the platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience is encouraged to apply, including strong freshers.
quality_excerpt: A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply. Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language. Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.
